svg.title: My journey as a git log
svg.desc: HEAD, TODAY: Building financial futures at Kettner Edelmetalle. E-commerce meets livestream selling: gold investing made easy for everyone. WORK-STUDY: Tried a work-study program. Dropped out within weeks. Four years of full-time experience, no time to wait. HIGH SCHOOL: Working for startups. Shipping real products for startups while still in high school. AGE 14: Our own game server, our first SaaS. Taught myself to code in forums, then sold subscriptions inside the game. AGE 13: Hooked on Arma 3. Gaming is what pulled me into tech. Turns out I loved building even more.
